rules.quoted_span: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
rules.interaction: Takes precedence over the state AB 1482 cap for covered units; non-RSO units fall under the JCO and state law.

all.unavailable: condominium or townhome tenancy commenced after 1995-12-31

rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties first built on or before 1978-10-01 (certificate of occupancy), plus replacement units under L.A.M.C. 151.28: apartments, condos and townhomes (not regulated for tenancies commencing after 1995-12-31), duplexes, multiple SFDs on one parcel, ADUs, mobile homes
rules.exemptions: luxury exemption (rent on or before 1978-05-31); condo/townhome tenancies commenced after 1995-12-31; temporary exemptions on registration
rules.key_value: annual allowable % set by LAHD (3% for 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 per D042); once per 12 months
rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: Rent in covered units may be raised once every 12 months by the annual allowable percentage published by LAHD; since Feb 2, 2026 no extra utility percentage or dependent add-on is allowed. Rent may go to market only after a vacancy event such as voluntary move-out or a buyout.

rules.interaction: RSO units are covered by this section; non-RSO units fall under the JCO (L.A.M.C. 165.00 et seq.).
rules.coverage_conditions: Units covered by the RSO (first built on or before 1978-10-01)
rules.key_value: just cause required; relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.title: Los Angeles RSO just cause for eviction and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: RSO tenants can be evicted only for listed at-fault reasons (non-payment, lease violation, nuisance, illegal use, refusal to renew, denying access, unapproved subtenant) or no-fault reasons (owner or family move-in, resident manager, demolition or removal from the market, government order, affordable housing conversion). No-fault evictions require relocation assistance.

notes: LAHD RSO overview (updated 2026-09-22). Effective dates shown: Feb 2, 2026 (utility and dependent add-ons removed), Mar 30, 2020 to Jan 31, 2024 freeze. No effective date for the RSO itself is given. The annual percentage lives on a separate page (D042). Just cause record has no date or amounts in this doc.
